sloka: ततः प्रजवनाश्वेन रथेन स महारथः।द्वारेण निर्ययौ तेन यत्र तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.९६.३३ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ prajavanāśvena rathena sa mahārathaḥ।dvāreṇa niryayau tena yatra tau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.96.33 ।।

translations.english: Then the Sun lost his radiance, and the four directions were enveloped by gloom, the birds made fearful noise and the earth shook.
